```yaml
name: Run Tests on Label

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  run-tests:
    if: github.event.label.name == 'run-tests'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
```
